task: Calculate the monthly EMI for a home loan of 5,00,000 INR at 9% annual interest for a 5-year tenure.

steps.content: EMI formula: EMI = P * r * (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1). Here P = 500000, annual rate = 9% so monthly r = 0.09/12 = 0.0075, n = 5*12 = 60 months.
Cross-checking: total repayment = 10379 * 60 = 622,740 INR. Interest paid = 122,740 INR. Figures are consistent with a 9% loan.
The monthly EMI for a home loan of INR 5,00,000 at 9% per annum for 5 years is INR 13,079.
